name: semantic-clusters-shape
description: The FFI shape fixture (EP-0009 M5, RFC-0008 lockstep): clustering over hand-built vectors must serialize to exactly this value in every crust, through `matra::clusters` with an embedder that returns these vectors in Rust, and through `matra.clusters` in Python, over a parsed document with one sentence per vector. `expect` is a Clusters without its provenance, with the two parameters the provenance records; `embedder` is the identity the embedder reports, in the shape the parser reports its own. The embeddings are chosen so a~b and b~c clear the 0.92 threshold while a~c does not (the chained-restatement case), index 3 is a zero vector (no geometry, no claim), and index 4 is a singleton.
